name: awesome-kit
description: Christina's cross-domain skills: the task system (file-backed task/issue tracking -- folders as source of truth, embedded task_list references, 14 verbs; evolved from the hand-off skill in 0.8.0, which it replaces), a shared communication framework (task + verbose-updates), /plugin-ecosystem (interactive 16:9 HTML poster of marketplaces and plugins), and /html-pdf (convert an HTML file to PDF via headless Chromium and open it). Depends on plugins-kit:skills-kit for the shared audit framework and the skills_kit_lib shared library (schema validation + document walking).
